description.value: Rimrock Café is a well-established Whistler Creekside restaurant that has been serving guests since 1986, celebrating its 40th anniversary in 2026. The kitchen emphasizes sustainability and seasonality, with a menu crafted around local ingredients. It offers full sit-down dining, group bookings, and private event options, positioning it as a destination-worthy meal stop on a Whistler cycling tour.
